resolutions.note: Photo.start() needs a short ignition stream first, as in Meta’s own sample (d53e495).
Gary DM’d the ingest token; the next shutter photo reached in_graph in 5 s.
Presses are queued now (c10dde4); medium/medium for a day of button photos.
Barometric floor from CMAltimeter, confirmed by the pedometer; the walk reached level 4 with the right count.
The 3D site view became the console’s map (PR #27, 02:07).
ECSW measures 5.5 m per floor; default changed, stair/elevator gate widened to 40 m (e12fa74).
